tasks_completed.description: Rewrote check-budget-overage.py with multi-currency field resolution
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced hard-coded EUR-only field lookups with CURRENCY_FIELDS map, currency auto-detection, and a generic candidate-path search covering root, summary, data, data.trip_summary, and data.days[0].budget_vs_user. Renamed threshold_eur parameter to threshold_amount. Output currency symbol is now derived from detected currency. Error message lists all accepted field names and paths.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: script authored for EUR-only plans. CNY plan field names (overage_cny, overage_percent) under data.trip_summary were never added to the lookup logic when the budget agent added CNY support around commit cb6cc4d.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: cb6cc4d -- fix: deploy slug parsing bug + budget.json USD to CNY conversion
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Budget agent started emitting CNY field names (overage_cny, overage_percent, trip_summary) in budget.json but check-budget-overage.py was not updated to match, leaving it EUR-only.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: CURRENCY_FIELDS lookup table covers both EUR and CNY field name variants. _detect_currency probes all candidate nodes to determine plan currency before resolving fields. Threshold comparison uses native currency units directly.

test_results.output: Error: Missing overage fields — lists all accepted field names and paths

dev.qa_notes: Run the three test commands above. Also test data/china-feb-15-mar-7-2026-20260202-195429/budget.json which should also exit 2 (no trip-level summary). Verify CNY output shows ¥ symbol not €. Verify EUR output still shows € symbol.

recommendations: If future currencies are added to the budget agent, add a new entry to CURRENCY_FIELDS in check-budget-overage.py to keep parity.

Consider adding data.days[0].budget_vs_user fallback aggregation for multi-day plans that lack a trip_summary node (china-feb-15, china-exchange) — currently those plans correctly exit 2, but a sum-of-days approach would allow threshold checking on them.
